q: पद्म विभूषण 2026 के पाँच विजेताओं में से किन दो व्यक्तित्वों को विशेष रूप से 'लोक कार्य (Public Affairs)' के क्षेत्र में सम्मानित किया गया?
e:
Out of the five Padma Vibhushan 2026 awardees, Justice K.T. Thomas and veteran leader V.S. Achuthanandan were honoured for Public Affairs; Dharmendra and N. Rajam for Art; and P. Narayanan for Literature & Education.
पद्म विभूषण 2026 में के.टी. थॉमस तथा वी.एस. अच्युतानन्दन को 'लोक कार्य' क्षेत्र में सम्मानित किया गया।
Booster Facts: (1) N. Rajam is an acclaimed Hindustani classical violinist of the Gayaki Ang. (2) Padma Awards are conferred by the President of India at Rashtrapati Bhavan.
qe: Among the five recipients of the Padma Vibhushan 2026, which two personalities were honoured specifically in the field of 'Public Affairs'?

q: दिग्गज अभिनेता अनंत नाग (दादासाहेब फाल्के पुरस्कार 2024, सितंबर 2026) तथा गीतकार-कवि आर. वैरामुत्तु (60वाँ ज्ञानपीठ पुरस्कार, मार्च 2026) क्रमशः किन दो भारतीय भाषाओं/उद्योगों से प्रमुखतः जुड़े हैं?
e:
Anant Nag is an iconic actor of Kannada cinema (along with Hindi & Marathi works), while R. Vairamuthu is a celebrated Tamil poet and lyricist who won the 60th Jnanpith Award in March 2026.
अनंत नाग कन्नड़ सिनेमा तथा आर. वैरामुत्तु तमिल साहित्य से जुड़े हैं।
Booster Facts: (1) Dadasaheb Phalke Award is presented by the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting during the National Film Awards. (2) Jnanpith Award is presented annually by Bharatiya Jnanpith.
qe: Veteran actor Anant Nag (Dadasaheb Phalke Award 2024, conferred Sept 2026) and lyricist-poet R. Vairamuthu (60th Jnanpith Award, Mar 2026) are primarily associated with which two Indian languages/industries respectively?

q:
अक्टूबर 2026 में उत्तर प्रदेश के प्रौद्योगिकी और कौशल अभियान के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित दो कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: औद्योगिक रोबोटिक्स और स्वचालन को बढ़ावा देने हेतु ग्रेटर नोएडा में 'प्रगति (PRAGATI) रोबोटिक्स पार्क' लॉन्च किया गया।
कथन II: उत्तर प्रदेश सरकार ने युवाओं की रोजगार क्षमता बढ़ाने के लिए ₹1,725 करोड़ की कौशल प्रशिक्षण योजना को मंजूरी दी।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: Neither Statement I nor Statement II
Both Statement I and Statement II
e:
Both statements are verified October 2026 developments in Uttar Pradesh aimed at making the state a leading manufacturing and skilled-manpower hub.
कथन I और कथन II दोनों सही हैं।
Booster Facts: (1) Greater Noida lies in Gautam Buddh Nagar district under the NCR. (2) UP targets becoming a $1 trillion state economy through industrial corridors and skilling.
qe:
Consider the following two statements regarding Uttar Pradesh's technology and skilling push in October 2026:
Statement I: The PRAGATI Robotics Park was launched in Greater Noida to foster industrial robotics and automation.
Statement II: The Uttar Pradesh government approved a ₹1,725 crore Skill Training Scheme to upgrade youth employability.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
oe: Neither Statement I nor Statement II
Both Statement I and Statement II

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में इसरो (ISRO) की उपग्रह उपलब्धियों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: NVS-03 belongs to the second-generation NavIC regional navigation satellite series.
GSAT-7C is a dedicated defence communication satellite for the Indian armed forces.
Both NVS-03 and GSAT-7C were developed under ISRO's space programme.
GSAT-7C is a deep-space lunar rover mission designed to land on the Moon's south pole.
e:
Statement D is NOT correct: GSAT-7C is a geostationary defence communication satellite (following GSAT-7 Rukmini for Navy and GSAT-7A for Air Force), NOT a lunar rover mission.
विकल्प D असत्य है क्योंकि GSAT-7C एक रक्षा संचार उपग्रह है, न कि चंद्र रोवर मिशन।
Booster Facts: (1) Chandrayaan-3 (Aug 2023) made India the first country to soft-land near the lunar south pole (Shiv Shakti Point). (2) NVS satellites carry indigenous Rubidium atomic clocks.
qe: Which of the following statements regarding ISRO's October 2026 satellite milestones is NOT correct?
oe: NVS-03 belongs to the second-generation NavIC regional navigation satellite series.
GSAT-7C is a dedicated defence communication satellite for the Indian armed forces.
Both NVS-03 and GSAT-7C were developed under ISRO's space programme.
GSAT-7C is a deep-space lunar rover mission designed to land on the Moon's south pole.

q: क्रमशः भारत का पहला पूर्ण जैविक राज्य (2016) तथा भारत का पहला पूर्ण जैविक केंद्र शासित प्रदेश (नवंबर 2026) बनने का गौरव किन दो को प्राप्त है?
e:
Sikkim became India's (and the world's) first 100% Organic State in 2016, while Ladakh became India's first fully Organic Union Territory in November 2026 (alongside the National Saffron Mission spotlight).
सिक्किम भारत का पहला पूर्ण जैविक राज्य (2016) और लद्दाख पहला पूर्ण जैविक केंद्र शासित प्रदेश (नवंबर 2026) है।
Booster Facts: (1) Organic certification in India is overseen by APEDA under NPOP (National Programme for Organic Production). (2) Ladakh became a Union Territory on 31 October 2019.
qe: Which pair of states/UTs holds the distinction of being India's FIRST fully Organic State (2016) and India's FIRST fully Organic Union Territory (November 2026) respectively?

q:
अक्टूबर 2026 में शैक्षिक और भाषाई उपलब्धियों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: शिक्षा मंत्रालय ने शोध और संरक्षण को बढ़ावा देने हेतु 5 शास्त्रीय भाषा उत्कृष्टता केंद्र (CoEs) स्थापित किए।
कथन II: लक्षद्वीप ने ULLAS (नव भारत साक्षरता कार्यक्रम) पहल के अंतर्गत पूर्ण कार्यात्मक साक्षरता हासिल की।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
e:
Both statements are verified October 2026 milestones under the Ministry of Education. ULLAS implements NEP 2020's adult education vision (ages 15+) through volunteerism ('Jan-Jan Saakshar').
कथन I और कथन II दोनों सही हैं।
Booster Facts: (1) Tamil (2004) was India's first Classical Language, followed by Sanskrit (2005). (2) In October 2024, Marathi, Pali, Prakrit, Assamese, and Bengali were accorded Classical Language status, taking the total to 11.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding educational and linguistic milestones in October 2026:
Statement I: The Ministry of Education rolled out 5 Centres of Excellence (CoEs) for Classical Languages to advance research and preservation.
Statement II: Lakshadweep achieved full functional literacy under the ULLAS (Nav Bharat Saaksharta Karyakram) initiative.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का राजकीय पशु तथा राजकीय पक्षी क्रमशः कौन-से हैं?
e:
Uttar Pradesh's State Animal is Barasingha (Swamp Deer), State Bird is Sarus Crane (Krauch), State Tree is Ashoka, and State Flower is Palash (Tesu).
उत्तर प्रदेश का राजकीय पशु बारहसिंगा तथा राजकीय पक्षी सारस (क्रौंच) है।
Booster Facts: (1) UP's State Emblem (adopted 1938) features a bow-and-arrow, two fishes, and three waves representing Ganga-Yamuna-Saraswati confluence. (2) State Fish: Chitala (Moy).
qe: Which of the following is the State Animal and State Bird of Uttar Pradesh respectively?

q: आयतन की दृष्टि से भारत की सबसे बड़ी कृत्रिम झील 'गोविंद बल्लभ पंत सागर' उत्तर प्रदेश के सोनभद्र जिले में किस बाँध के पीछे निर्मित है?
e:
Rihand Dam (constructed on the Rihand River, a tributary of the Son, at Pipri in Sonbhadra district, UP) creates the Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar reservoir.
रिहंद बाँध (सोनभद्र, रिहंद नदी) के पीछे गोविंद बल्लभ पंत सागर झील बनी है।
Booster Facts: (1) Matatila Dam and Rajghat Dam are located on the Betwa River (Lalitpur/Jhansi region). (2) Sonbhadra is known as the 'Energy Capital of India' due to numerous thermal power plants (Singrauli/Anpara/Obra).
qe: The Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar, India's largest artificial lake by volume, is formed behind which dam in Sonbhadra district of Uttar Pradesh?

q: भारत के किस शास्त्रीय नृत्य की उत्पत्ति उत्तर प्रदेश में हुई और जो लखनऊ तथा बनारस घरानों (तथा गुरु पंडित बिरजू महाराज) से प्रसिद्ध रूप से जुड़ा है?
e:
Kathak is the classical dance form of North India / Uttar Pradesh, characterized by intricate footwork (tatkar), spins (chakkars), and storytelling (katha), with Lucknow, Banaras, and Jaipur gharanas.
कथक उत्तर प्रदेश का प्रमुख शास्त्रीय नृत्य है।
Booster Facts: (1) Pandit Birju Maharaj (Lucknow Gharana, Kalka-Bindadin lineage) received the Padma Vibhushan (1986). (2) Sangeet Natak Akademi recognizes 8 Indian classical dances: Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Manipuri, Mohiniyattam, and Sattriya.
qe: Which classical dance form of India originated in Uttar Pradesh and is famously associated with the Lucknow and Banaras Gharanas (and maestro Pandit Birju Maharaj)?

q:
सूची-I (उत्तर प्रदेश का प्रसिद्ध मेला) को सूची-II (जिला/स्थान) से सुमेलित कीजिए:
सूची-I:
1. नौचंदी मेला
2. बटेश्वर मेला (पशु मेला)
3. ददरी मेला
4. देवा शरीफ मेला
सूची-II:
(a) बाराबंकी
(b) बलिया
(c) आगरा
(d) मेरठ
e:
Nauchandi Fair = Meerut (held after Holi); Bateshwar Fair = Agra (banks of Yamuna); Dadri Fair = Ballia; Deva Sharif Fair (Haji Waris Ali Shah) = Barabanki.
सही सुमेलन 1-(d), 2-(c), 3-(b), 4-(a) है।
Booster Facts: (1) Sulahkul Utsav (Hindu-Muslim unity) is celebrated in Agra. (2) Shakumbhari Devi Fair = Saharanpur; Syed Salar Fair = Bahraich.
qe:
Match List-I (Famous Fair of UP) with List-II (District/Location):
List-I:
1. Nauchandi Fair
2. Bateshwar Fair (Cattle Fair)
3. Dadri Fair
4. Deva Sharif Fair
List-II:
(a) Barabanki
(b) Ballia
(c) Agra
(d) Meerut

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के 12 जिलों से होकर मेरठ से प्रयागराज तक 594 किमी लंबा कौन-सा एक्सप्रेस-वे भारत के सबसे लंबे ग्रीनफील्ड एक्सप्रेस-वे में से एक है?
e:
The 594 km Ganga Expressway connects Meerut (Bijauli village) to Prayagraj (Judapur Dandu village) across 12 districts of Uttar Pradesh.
गंगा एक्सप्रेस-वे (594 किमी) मेरठ से प्रयागराज तक 12 जिलों को जोड़ता है।
Booster Facts: (1) Purvanchal Expressway (341 km): Lucknow to Ghazipur. (2) Bundelkhand Expressway (296 km): Chitrakoot to Etawah. (3) Agra–Lucknow Expressway: 302 km.
qe: Which expressway in Uttar Pradesh, spanning 594 km from Meerut to Prayagraj across 12 districts, is planned as one of India's longest greenfield expressways?

q: जैन धर्म के 23वें तीर्थंकर कौन थे, जिनका जन्म वाराणसी (काशी) में हुआ था और जिनका प्रतीक चिह्न सर्प फण है?
e:
Parshvanatha (son of King Ashvasena of Varanasi) was the 23rd Tirthankara; he propounded four vows (Satya, Ahimsa, Asteya, Aparigraha), to which the 24th Tirthankara Mahavira added the fifth vow (Brahmacharya).
पार्श्वनाथ जैन धर्म के 23वें तीर्थंकर थे जिनका जन्म काशी (वाराणसी) में हुआ।
Booster Facts: (1) 1st Tirthankara: Rishabhanatha (Adinatha, symbol: Bull). (2) 24th Tirthankara: Vardhamana Mahavira (born Kundagrama, Vaishali; symbol: Lion).
qe: Who was the 23rd Tirthankara of Jainism, born in Varanasi (Kashi), whose symbol is the Hooded Serpent?

q: तेलुगु महाकाव्य 'आमुक्तमाल्यद' की रचना विजयनगर साम्राज्य के किस प्रख्यात शासक ने की थी, जिनके दरबार में 'अष्टदिग्गज' सुशोभित थे?
e:
Krishnadevaraya (Tuluva Dynasty, 1509–1529) authored 'Amuktamalyada' (Telugu) and 'Jambavati Kalyanam' (Sanskrit), and patronized the Ashtadiggajas (8 Telugu poets including Tenali Ramakrishna & Allasani Peddana).
कृष्णदेवराय ने 'आमुक्तमाल्यद' की रचना की और उनके दरबार में अष्टदिग्गज थे।
Booster Facts: (1) Vijayanagara Empire was founded in 1336 by Harihara I and Bukka Raya I (Sangama Dynasty) on the banks of the Tungabhadra River. (2) Battle of Talikota (1565) led to its decline.
qe: The Telugu epic 'Amuktamalyada' was authored by which celebrated ruler of the Vijayanagara Empire, whose court was adorned by the 'Ashtadiggajas'?

q: हल्दीघाटी का ऐतिहासिक युद्ध (जून 1576) मेवाड़ के महाराणा प्रताप तथा किसके नेतृत्व वाली मुगल सेना के बीच लड़ा गया था?
e:
The Battle of Haldighati (18 June 1576) was fought between Maharana Pratap (supported by Hakim Khan Sur and Bhil forces) and Emperor Akbar's Mughal army commanded by Raja Man Singh I of Amber and Asaf Khan.
हल्दीघाटी का युद्ध महाराणा प्रताप और मानसिंह प्रथम के नेतृत्व वाली मुगल सेना के बीच हुआ।
Booster Facts: (1) Second Battle of Panipat (1556): Akbar (Bairam Khan) vs Hemu. (2) Akbar abolished Jizya in 1564 and founded Din-i-Ilahi in 1582.
qe: The historic Battle of Haldighati (June 1576) was fought between Maharana Pratap of Mewar and the Mughal army led by:

q: 1916 में भारतीय होमरूल लीग आंदोलन किन दो नेताओं द्वारा स्वतंत्र रूप से प्रारंभ किया गया था?
o: Bal Gangadhar Tilak and Annie Besant
Mahatma Gandhi and Lala Lajpat Rai
Gopal Krishna Gokhale and Dadabhai Naoroji
Subhas Chandra Bose and C.R. Das
e:
Bal Gangadhar Tilak launched his Home Rule League in April 1916 (HQ: Poona — covering Maharashtra excluding Bombay, Karnataka, Central Provinces & Berar) and Annie Besant launched hers in September 1916 (HQ: Adyar, Madras — rest of India).
बाल गंगाधर तिलक (अप्रैल 1916) और एनी बेसेंट (सितंबर 1916) ने होमरूल लीग आंदोलन प्रारंभ किया।
Booster Facts: (1) Tilak gave the slogan "Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it". (2) Annie Besant edited 'New India' and 'Commonweal' and became the first woman President of INC (Calcutta, 1917).
qe: In 1916, the Indian Home Rule League movement was launched independently by which two leaders?
oe: Bal Gangadhar Tilak and Annie Besant
Mahatma Gandhi and Lala Lajpat Rai
Gopal Krishna Gokhale and Dadabhai Naoroji
Subhas Chandra Bose and C.R. Das

q: सितंबर 1932 में यरवदा सेंट्रल जेल में डॉ. बी.आर. अंबेडकर तथा महात्मा गांधी (गांधीजी की ओर से मदन मोहन मालवीय के हस्ताक्षर) के बीच 'पूना पैक्ट' किस ब्रिटिश घोषणा में संशोधन हेतु हुआ था?
e:
The Poona Pact (24 September 1932) modified British PM Ramsay MacDonald's Communal Award (Aug 1932), replacing separate electorates for the Depressed Classes with joint electorates and increased reserved seats (from 71 to 147 in provincial legislatures).
पूना पैक्ट (1932) रैम्ज़े मैकडोनाल्ड के सांप्रदायिक पंचाट (Communal Award) में संशोधन हेतु हुआ था।
Booster Facts: (1) Dr. B.R. Ambedkar attended all three Round Table Conferences (1930, 1931, 1932); Mahatma Gandhi attended only the Second RTC (1931).
qe: The Poona Pact of September 1932 was signed at Yerwada Central Jail between Dr. B.R. Ambedkar and Mahatma Gandhi (signed by Madan Mohan Malaviya on Gandhi's behalf) to modify which British announcement?

q: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद 'अस्पृश्यता' (Untouchability) का अंत करता है और किसी भी रूप में इसके आचरण को निषिद्ध करता है?
e:
Article 17 (Right to Equality, Part III) abolishes untouchability and makes its enforcement a punishable offence (operationalized via Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955 and SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act, 1989).
अनुच्छेद 17 अस्पृश्यता का उन्मूलन करता है।
Booster Facts: (1) Article 14 = Equality before Law; Article 15 = Prohibition of discrimination; Article 16 = Equality of opportunity in public employment; Article 18 = Abolition of Titles.
qe: Which Article of the Constitution of India abolishes 'Untouchability' and forbids its practice in any form?

q: विश्वविद्यालय अनुदान आयोग (UGC) संसद के एक अधिनियम द्वारा किस वर्ष भारत सरकार का सांविधिक निकाय बना?
e:
UGC was inaugurated in December 1953 and became a statutory body under the UGC Act, 1956 for coordination, determination, and maintenance of standards of university education in India.
UGC अधिनियम, 1956 के द्वारा UGC एक सांविधिक निकाय बना।
Booster Facts: (1) NCERT was established in 1961 (registered society, HQ: New Delhi). (2) AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education) got statutory status in 1987; NCTE (National Council for Teacher Education) got statutory status in 1995 (Act of 1993).
qe: The University Grants Commission (UGC) became a statutory body of the Government of India by an Act of Parliament in which year?

q: अनुच्छेद 54 के अंतर्गत भारत के राष्ट्रपति के चुनाव हेतु निर्वाचक मंडल (Electoral College) में निम्नलिखित में से कौन भाग लेते हैं?
o: All elected and nominated members of Parliament and State Assemblies
Elected members of both Houses of Parliament and elected members of State Legislative Assemblies (including Delhi & Puducherry)
Elected members of Lok Sabha and State Legislative Councils only
Only the elected members of Rajya Sabha and Vidhan Sabha
e:
Under Article 54, the Presidential Electoral College comprises ONLY ELECTED members of Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, and State Legislative Assemblies (plus UTs of Delhi & Puducherry via 70th Amendment, 1992). Nominated members and State Legislative Councils (MLCs) do NOT vote.
राष्ट्रपति चुनाव में केवल संसद के दोनों सदनों तथा राज्यों (व दिल्ली-पुदुचेरी) की विधानसभाओं के निर्वाचित सदस्य भाग लेते हैं।
Booster Facts: (1) Election uses Proportional Representation by Single Transferable Vote (Article 55). (2) Disputes in Presidential/VP elections are decided exclusively by the Supreme Court (Article 71).
qe: Who among the following participates in the Electoral College for the election of the President of India under Article 54?
oe: All elected and nominated members of Parliament and State Assemblies
Elected members of both Houses of Parliament and elected members of State Legislative Assemblies (including Delhi & Puducherry)
Elected members of Lok Sabha and State Legislative Councils only
Only the elected members of Rajya Sabha and Vidhan Sabha

q: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय को 'अभिलेख न्यायालय' (Court of Record) घोषित किया गया है जिसे स्वयं की अवमानना के लिए दंड देने की शक्ति प्राप्त है?
e:
Article 129 declares the Supreme Court to be a Court of Record (its judgments have evidentiary value and precedent binding on all courts under Art. 141) with power to punish for contempt. (High Courts are Courts of Record under Article 215.)
अनुच्छेद 129 सर्वोच्च न्यायालय को अभिलेख न्यायालय घोषित करता है।
Booster Facts: (1) Article 124 = Establishment of Supreme Court; Article 136 = Special Leave Petition (SLP); Article 143 = President's power to consult Supreme Court (Advisory Jurisdiction).
qe: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is the Supreme Court of India designated as a 'Court of Record' with the power to punish for contempt of itself?

q: भारतीय स्कूली शिक्षा में 'त्रिभाषा सूत्र (Three-Language Formula)' को पहली बार किस राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति में औपचारिक रूप से अपनाया गया था?
e:
Based on the Kothari Commission (1964–66) recommendations, the Three-Language Formula was first formally incorporated in India's first National Policy on Education (NPE) 1968, and continued with greater flexibility in NEP 2020.
त्रिभाषा सूत्र को सर्वप्रथम राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति, 1968 में औपचारिक रूप से अपनाया गया था।
Booster Facts: (1) NEP 2020 states no language will be imposed on any state, and at least two of the three languages learned must be native to India.
qe: The 'Three-Language Formula' in Indian school education was formally adopted in which National Policy on Education for the first time?

q: ऐतिहासिक सिल्क रूट पर भारत को तिब्बत (चीन) से जोड़ने वाला सामरिक पर्वतीय दर्रा 'नाथू ला' भारत के किस राज्य में स्थित है?
e:
Nathu La Pass (and Jelep La) is located in East Sikkim in the Himalayas.
नाथू ला दर्रा सिक्किम राज्य में स्थित है।
Booster Facts: (1) Himachal Pradesh passes: Rohtang, Shipki La, Baralacha La. (2) Uttarakhand passes: Lipulekh, Mana, Niti. (3) J&K/Ladakh: Zoji La, Banihal, Karakoram. (4) Arunachal Pradesh: Bomdi La, Diphu.
qe: Nathu La Pass, a strategic mountain pass on the historic Silk Route connecting India with Tibet (China), is located in which Indian state?

q: भारत के उत्तरी मैदानों में नदियों की वार्षिक बाढ़ से निर्मित नई और अत्यंत उपजाऊ जलोढ़ मिट्टी वाले क्षेत्र को क्या कहा जाता है?
e:
Khadar refers to the newer, more fertile alluvial deposits found along active river floodplains, whereas Bhangar denotes older, slightly elevated alluvial terraces containing calcareous nodules (kankar).
नई उपजाऊ जलोढ़ मिट्टी को 'खादर' तथा पुरानी जलोढ़ को 'बांगर' कहते हैं।
Booster Facts: (1) Bhabar is the coarse pebble belt at the Himalayan foothills where streams disappear underground; Terai is the marshy re-emergence belt south of Bhabar.
qe: In the Northern Plains of India, what are the newly deposited, very fertile alluvial floodplains renewed annually by river floods called?

q: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, भारत के किस राज्य में शहरी जनसंख्या का प्रतिशत सर्वाधिक (सबसे अधिक नगरीकृत राज्य) दर्ज किया गया?
e:
In Census 2011, Goa was India's most urbanized state by percentage (62.17% urban), followed by Mizoram (52.11%) and Tamil Nadu (48.40%). Himachal Pradesh was the most rural state (~90% rural).
जनगणना 2011 में प्रतिशत की दृष्टि से सर्वाधिक नगरीकृत राज्य गोवा (62.17%) था।
Booster Facts: (1) Overall India urbanization in Census 2011 was 31.16% (UP: 22.27%). (2) By absolute urban population, Maharashtra ranked first followed by Uttar Pradesh.
qe: According to Census 2011, which Indian state recorded the HIGHEST percentage of urban population (most urbanized state)?

q: योजना आयोग के स्थान पर नीति आयोग (NITI Aayog) किस तिथि को अस्तित्व में आया?
e:
NITI Aayog was constituted by a Union Cabinet resolution on 1 January 2015 as the premier policy think tank of the Government of India, promoting cooperative and competitive federalism.
नीति आयोग की स्थापना 1 जनवरी 2015 को हुई थी।
Booster Facts: (1) Prime Minister is the ex-officio Chairperson of NITI Aayog. (2) NITI Aayog is an extra-constitutional, non-statutory executive body.
qe: NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India), which replaced the Planning Commission, came into existence on which date?

q: RBI अधिनियम, 1934 (2016 में संशोधित) के अंतर्गत नीतिगत रेपो दर तय करने वाली भारत की मौद्रिक नीति समिति (MPC) में कुल कितने सदस्य होते हैं?
e:
The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) has 6 members—3 officials from RBI (including the RBI Governor as ex-officio Chairperson with a casting vote in case of tie) and 3 external members appointed by the Government of India.
मौद्रिक नीति समिति (MPC) में कुल 6 सदस्य (3 RBI + 3 केंद्र सरकार द्वारा नामित) होते हैं।
Booster Facts: (1) India's statutory inflation target under Flexible Inflation Targeting (FIT) is 4% CPI inflation with a ±2% tolerance band (2% to 6%).
qe: How many total members constitute India's Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) under the RBI Act, 1934 (amended 2016) to decide the benchmark policy Repo Rate?

q: भारत के उपभोक्ता मूल्य सूचकांक (CPI) तथा थोक मूल्य सूचकांक (WPI) के बीच कौन-सा मुख्य अंतर सही है?
o: CPI includes both goods and services (like education and healthcare), whereas WPI covers only goods.
WPI includes services, whereas CPI covers only agricultural goods.
Both CPI and WPI are compiled by the Reserve Bank of India.
WPI is used by RBI as the primary nominal anchor for monetary policy inflation targeting.
e:
CPI (compiled by NSO, MoSPI) measures retail prices of both goods AND services (food, housing, education, health) and is RBI's primary inflation gauge, whereas WPI (compiled by Office of Economic Adviser, DPIIT) covers ONLY goods at wholesale level.
CPI में वस्तुएँ और सेवाएँ दोनों शामिल होती हैं, जबकि WPI में केवल वस्तुएँ शामिल होती हैं।
Booster Facts: (1) Current base year for CPI-Combined = 2012; for WPI = 2011-12.
qe: Which key distinction between India's Consumer Price Index (CPI) and Wholesale Price Index (WPI) is correct?
oe: CPI includes both goods and services (like education and healthcare), whereas WPI covers only goods.
WPI includes services, whereas CPI covers only agricultural goods.
Both CPI and WPI are compiled by the Reserve Bank of India.
WPI is used by RBI as the primary nominal anchor for monetary policy inflation targeting.

q: एक स्वस्थ वयस्क मनुष्य का सामान्य विश्राम रक्तचाप (सिस्टोलिक / डायस्टोलिक) कितना होता है?
e:
Normal adult human blood pressure is 120/80 mmHg (120 mmHg systolic during ventricular contraction, 80 mmHg diastolic during relaxation), measured by a Sphygmomanometer.
स्वस्थ वयस्क का सामान्य रक्तचाप 120/80 mmHg होता है।
Booster Facts: (1) The natural pacemaker of the human heart is the SA Node (Sinoatrial Node) located in the right atrium. (2) Normal resting adult heart rate is ~72 beats per minute.
qe: What is the normal resting blood pressure (systolic / diastolic) of a healthy adult human being?

सूची-I (भौतिक राशि) को सूची-II (SI मात्रक) से सुमेलित कीजिए:
सूची-I:

qe:

q: कंप्यूटर सिस्टम में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा युग्म RAM को ROM से सही रूप से अलग करता है?
o: RAM is non-volatile and read-only; ROM is volatile and stores running apps.
RAM is volatile primary memory holding active programs/data; ROM is non-volatile memory storing permanent boot firmware (BIOS/UEFI).
Both RAM and ROM lose all data immediately when power is switched off.
RAM is secondary optical storage, whereas ROM is cloud storage.
e:
RAM (Random Access Memory) is volatile read/write main memory used for actively executing programs; ROM (Read-Only Memory) is non-volatile and retains permanent startup instructions (BIOS/UEFI) even without power.
RAM अस्थायी (volatile) मुख्य मेमोरी है, जबकि ROM स्थायी (non-volatile) मेमोरी है जिसमें बूट फ़र्मवेयर सुरक्षित रहता है।
Booster Facts: (1) Cache memory (SRAM) is faster than main RAM (DRAM). (2) Cold booting starts a powered-off computer; Warm booting restarts an already running computer (Ctrl+Alt+Del).
qe: Which of the following pairs correctly distinguishes RAM from ROM in a computer system?
oe: RAM is non-volatile and read-only; ROM is volatile and stores running apps.
RAM is volatile primary memory holding active programs/data; ROM is non-volatile memory storing permanent boot firmware (BIOS/UEFI).
